blocks.text: Shanaia Gomez piqued the curiosity of netizens after revealing messages from an unnamed male celebrity who seemingly tried to hit on her when she was still a minor. Through her TikTok page on Monday, Sept. 14, the actress shared screenshots of some of the “most interesting direct messages” she received on Instagram. One of the messages she revealed was from a Filipino celebrity “much older” than her, who first reached out to her in 2016 when she was just 14 years old.
